name: Fremont Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: You raise issues that matter to teens and pass them to the City Council. You also help plan forums and workshops for other teens.
who_can_apply: The page does not state ages, grades or residency rules. Ask the Recreation Division.
deadline_text: The page does not say when applications open.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to apply. Call the Recreation Division at 510-494-4300.
notes: Meets 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. on the first Monday of each month except July and August, at City Hall, 3300 Capitol Ave. The page lists 12 members.
